title: Temporal State Transport in Video Generation: Diagnosing and Correcting Spectral Imbalance
abstract: arXiv:2609.08505v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable video generation requires more than high-quality frames to form a coherent story: a model must maintain a persistent state, transporting visual attributes such as identity, scene layout, motion, and fine details across time. Existing training-free methods mainly strengthen cross-frame attention or analyze local attention entropy, but these views do not reveal whether temporal interactions stay in a healthy transport regime. In this work, we study video generation through the perspective of Temporal State Transport. We introduce Spectral Tension, a signed diagnostic that compares local attention diffuseness with global spectral diversity, and use it to identify two opposite temporal failures: fragmented transport and over-mixing hotspots. Based on this diagnosis, we propose Spectral Transport Homeostasis, a training-free regulator that softly corrects pathological temporal states while largely preserving balanced ones. Experime

translated_title: 视频生成中的时间状态传输：诊断与校正频谱失衡
translated_abstract: 可靠的视频生成不仅仅需要高质量的帧来构成连贯的故事：模型必须维持一个持久的状态，将身份、场景布局、运动和细节等视觉属性在时间维度上进行传输。现有的免训练方法主要是加强跨帧注意力或分析局部注意力熵，但这些视角无法揭示时间交互是否保持在健康的传输区间。在这项工作中，我们从“时间状态传输”的视角来研究视频生成。我们引入了“频谱张力”，这是一种带符号的诊断指标，用于比较局部注意力的扩散程度与全局频谱多样性，并利用它来识别两种截然相反的时间失败模式：碎片化传输和过度混合热点。基于这一诊断，我们提出了“频谱传输稳态”，一种免训练的调节器，能够在很大程度上保留平衡的时间状态的同时，温和地纠正病态的时间状态。实验……
tldr: 该论文提出“频谱张力”这一带符号的诊断指标，用于识别视频生成中碎片化传输与过度混合两类时间失衡问题，并提出免训练的“频谱传输稳态”调节器，在保留平衡状态的同时温和纠正病态时间状态。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Spectral Tension, a signed diagnostic for identifying fragmented transport and over-mixing temporal failures in video generation, and proposes Spectral Transport Homeostasis, a training-free regulator that softly corrects pathological temporal states while preserving balanced ones.
